[USER] User inquired about using Interactive Brokers API or IB_insync in TensorTrade.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, you can use Interactive Brokers' API and the IB_insync library with TensorTrade.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Interactive Brokers is a well-known online brokerage firm that provides access to various financial markets, including stocks, options, futures, and forex.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] They offer a range of APIs that allow developers to integrate their platform with custom software, including the Interactive Brokers API and the IB Gateway API.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] IB_insync is a third-party Python library that simplifies the process of using the Interactive Brokers API by providing a higher-level interface and additional functionality.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To use Interactive Brokers' API and IB_insync with TensorTrade, you will need to install both libraries and set up an account with Interactive Brokers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] You will then need to obtain API keys and follow the instructions provided by Interactive Brokers to set up the API connection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Once you have set up the API connection, you can use IB_insync to interact with the Interactive Brokers API and access data and trading functionality within TensorTrade.
